noAccess.title: You don't have access to supplier invoices
noAccess.body: Your role does not include reading supplier invoices. Finance, buyers and the owner have it.

band.label: Supplier invoices
band.sdiUnknown: The last SDI pickup could not be read
band.noSdiAccount: No SDI account for receiving invoices
band.lastPickupByPerson: Last SDI pickup {time} (asked by a person)

held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.manage: Your role cannot register or map supplier invoices.
held.upload: Your role cannot upload files: the invoice's PDF is uploaded first.
held.approve: Your role cannot approve supplier invoices.
held.pay: An invoice is paid once approved.
held.accept: Your role cannot accept a difference: the buyer or finance does.
held.noSdiAccount: The company has no SDI account for receiving invoices: set it up in Admin › Connections & API.
held.noIntermediary: No SDI intermediary is chosen yet: nothing can be picked up.
held.noneApprovable: None of the chosen invoices waits for approval.
held.proposalLater: Payment proposals come later (W2b): mark each invoice paid on its Payment tab for now.
held.selfInvoicesLater: Self-invoices for purchases from abroad come later (W2b).
held.lastLine: An invoice keeps at least one line.
held.edit: Only a typed invoice that is received or disputed is corrected.
held.editSdi: It came through SDI: what it says never changes (the supplier's credit note corrects it).
held.map: Its lines are mapped while it is received or disputed.
held.dispute: Only a received invoice is rejected (disputed with the supplier).
held.reopen: Only a disputed invoice is reopened.
held.withdraw: Only an approved invoice not paid yet has its approval withdrawn.
held.void: Only a typed invoice that is received or disputed is voided.
held.voidSdi: It came through SDI: a fiscal document is never voided (the supplier's credit note answers it).

tile.title: To handle
tile.failed: Couldn't load what there is to handle
tile.NEW_FROM_SDIHint: Arrived through SDI, not looked at yet
tile.DIFFERENCESHint: Lines outside the tolerance, not accepted yet

list.title: Supplier invoices
list.hint: Arrived through SDI or typed from a PDF, with the match result. Amounts are costs.
list.noCost: Amounts are not shown: your role does not see purchase costs.

empty.title: No supplier invoices yet
empty.body: Invoices arrive here from SDI; a foreign supplier's is added from its PDF.

noMatch.title: No invoices match these filters
noMatch.body: Clear a filter or the search.

match.title: Ordered, received, invoiced
match.stale: The goods, the order or other invoices changed since: match it again.
match.explain: We pay only for what we ordered at the agreed price and what really arrived. Differences go to the buyer before payment.
match.allWithin: Every line matches within the tolerance.
match.someUnmapped_one: {count} line has no order yet: map it on Lines.
match.someUnmapped_other: {count} lines have no order yet: map them on Lines.
match.areaLater: The leather area check (invoiced square feet against those measured at receipt) and the area claim come later (W2b).

empty.title: No PO linked
empty.body: Choose the PO on Lines, or mark it as an invoice without PO.

creditNote.title: A credit note is not matched
creditNote.body: A credit note takes off what its lines' orders were billed; it is never matched against receipts.

pickup.waiting_one: {count} delivery waits at the intermediary: it cannot be recorded (see the pickup's history).
pickup.waiting_other: {count} deliveries wait at the intermediary: they cannot be recorded (see the pickup's history).

foreign.title: Add foreign invoice
foreign.subtitle: A foreign supplier's invoice, typed from its PDF. An Italian supplier's arrives through SDI.
foreign.supplierHint: Code or name of a supplier or workshop
foreign.vatNatureHint: With VAT 0: the nature, e.g. N2.1 (outside the scope) or N6.x (reverse charge)
foreign.fileHint: The supplier's PDF: it is kept with the invoice (legal archive).
foreign.after: It is registered as a service without PO: map its lines to an order on its Lines tab if it bills one. Someone else approves it.

problem.issueDate: Give the invoice's date (today or earlier).
problem.currency: The currency is three letters, e.g. EUR.
problem.vat: Type the VAT amount (0 when none).
problem.vatNature: With VAT 0, give the nature (N1 … N7, e.g. N2.1).

record.title: Supplier invoice
record.dockHint: The invoice's thread beside the tabs (⌘J)
record.readOnly: Read-only: your role sees the invoice and changes nothing.
record.noPanels: The thread is not available here.

not_found.title: Supplier invoice not found
not_found.body: It does not exist, or your role does not reach its company or supplier.

forbidden.title: You can't open this invoice
forbidden.body: Your role does not reach this company or supplier.

lines.title: Lines
lines.typedHint: Typed from the supplier's PDF: change, add or remove lines while it is received.
lines.sdiHint: Read from the XML SDI delivered: what it says never changes; choose the order each line bills (saved at once).
lines.withoutOrder_one: Mark it as an invoice without PO ({count} line)
lines.withoutOrder_other: Mark it as an invoice without PO ({count} lines)
lines.candidatesFailed: Couldn't read the orders the lines may bill.
lines.noCost: Prices and amounts are not shown: your role does not see purchase costs.

approval.title: Approval
approval.registeredSdi: Delivered by SDI (nobody of the office typed it)
approval.ready: Ready for approval: matched, nothing left to accept.
approval.rules: Whoever typed an invoice does not approve it; an invoice delivered by SDI may be approved by anyone who approves. Approving does not pay it: payment is recorded once the transfer left the bank.
approval.dualLater: A second approval above a limit comes later (W2b).

payment.title: Payment
payment.batchLater: Not in a payment batch (batches come later, W2b)
payment.noTerms: The invoice names no payment terms.
payment.ibanLater: Whether the IBAN can be used is checked later (W2b): compare it with the supplier's bank details before paying.

approve.title: Approve {number}?
approve.body: {supplier}'s invoice becomes payable. It does not pay it: mark it paid once the transfer left the bank.

accept.title: Accept the difference
accept.body: Paying more than ordered (or before the goods arrived) is a decision in words: it is kept with the invoice.
accept.reasonHint: E.g. the price agreed by phone with the supplier

sendToBuyer.title: Send the differences to the buyer
sendToBuyer.body: An internal note on the invoice's thread names each line outside the tolerance (no price) and tells who sent the order.

dispute.title: Reject {number}?
dispute.body: It is disputed with the supplier: it is not approved or paid until it is reopened or credited.

reopen.title: Reopen {number}?
reopen.body: It is received again: it can be matched and approved.

void.title: Void {number}?
void.body: A typed invoice registered by mistake is voided; it stays in the history.

pay.title: Mark {number} paid
pay.body: Record the day the transfer left the bank and its reference.
pay.refHint: The CRO / TRN of the transfer

withoutOrder.title: An invoice without PO
withoutOrder.body_one: {count} goods line without an order becomes a service: it is approved without a match.
withoutOrder.body_other: {count} goods lines without an order become services: they are approved without a match.

line.problemQuantity: The quantity is a number above 0 (up to 4 decimals).
line.problemPrice: The unit price is a number above 0 (up to 6 decimals).

problem.day: Give the day it was paid.
problem.future: The payment cannot be dated after today.
problem.beforeIssue: The payment cannot be dated before the invoice.

notice.sentToBuyer_one: Sent to the buyer: {count} person told.
notice.sentToBuyer_other: Sent to the buyer: {count} people told.
notice.notReached_one: {count} person who sent the order cannot read the invoice's thread.
notice.notReached_other: {count} people who sent the order cannot read the invoice's thread.
notice.withoutOrder: Marked as an invoice without PO.

refusal.NOT_RECEIVED: Only a received invoice is approved.
refusal.OWN_INVOICE: You entered this invoice, so someone else approves it.
refusal.NO_LINES: The invoice has no lines: add them from its PDF first.
refusal.NOT_MATCHED: Map every goods or subcontract line to its order (or mark it as an invoice without PO) first.
refusal.WAITING_GOODS: The goods invoiced have not all arrived yet: approve it once they are received, or accept each difference in words.
refusal.DIFFERENCES: A difference outside the tolerance is accepted in words first, or the invoice is disputed with the supplier.
refusal.NO_XML: The XML SDI delivered is not stored yet: pick up again before approving.
refusal.LINES_DO_NOT_ADD_UP: The lines' net does not add up to the invoice's taxable amount: correct the lines or the totals first.
refusal.NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved invoice not paid yet is paid or has its approval withdrawn.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: Its lines change only while it is received or disputed.
refusal.FROM_SDI: It came through SDI: what it says never changes (only how its lines are mapped).
refusal.COMES_THROUGH_SDI: An Italian supplier's invoice arrives through SDI (the XML is the legal invoice): pick it up from SDI instead of typing it.
refusal.DUPLICATE: This supplier's invoice with this number and date is registered already.
refusal.NOTHING_UNMAPPED: No goods line is without an order.
refusal.NOT_ALLOWED_NOW: This change is not allowed in the invoice's state now.
refusal.WITHIN_TOLERANCE: This line matches within the tolerance: there is nothing to accept.
refusal.NO_DIFFERENCES: Every matched line is within the tolerance: there is nothing to send to the buyer.
refusal.THREAD_CLOSED: The invoice's thread is closed: reopen it to send the differences.
refusal.NOT_A_CREDIT_NOTE: A claim is settled by the supplier's credit note: this is an invoice.
refusal.VOIDED: A voided credit note settles nothing.
refusal.OTHER_SUPPLIER: The claim is of another supplier or company.
refusal.NOT_ACCEPTED_FOR_CREDIT: A credit note settles a claim the supplier accepted for a credit.
refusal.NO_INTERMEDIARY: No SDI intermediary is chosen yet: nothing can be picked up.
refusal.INTERMEDIARY_UNAVAILABLE: The SDI intermediary did not answer: try again in a few minutes.
refusal.NO_SDI_ACCOUNT: The company has no active SDI account for receiving invoices.
refusal.other: The change was refused as it stands.

read.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not reach this.
read.unavailable: The factory server did not answer: try again.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

write.moved: Someone changed the invoice meanwhile: it was read again; check and try once more.
write.state: The invoice's state does not allow this now: it was read again.
write.invalid: Some of what you typed was refused: check the fields.
write.paidOn: The payment day is outside the invoice's date and today.
write.mapping: That order cannot be billed by this line (another supplier, company, currency, or an order not sent).
write.lines: Check the lines: one was refused.
write.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
write.forbidden: Your role cannot do this here.
write.not_found: The invoice is no longer there.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The factory server did not answer: try again.
write.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

xml.title: Supplier invoice as received
xml.heading: {number} as received
xml.typed: Typed from the supplier's PDF: there is no XML.
xml.noXml: A typed invoice has no XML: its PDF is the copy we keep.
xml.missing: The XML file is not in the file store: pick the invoice up from SDI again, or ask an administrator.
xml.textLabel: The XML as SDI delivered it
xml.noCost: The XML holds the prices: your role does not see purchase costs, so it is not shown.

po.title: Supplier invoices of this order
po.hint: Invoices with a line on this order, matched in Finance. Amounts are costs.
po.noCost: Amounts are not shown: your role does not see purchase costs.

empty.title: No invoice yet
empty.body: When the supplier's invoice arrives and names this order, it shows here.

noAccess.title: Supplier invoices are Finance's
noAccess.body: Your role does not include reading supplier invoices.

po.more: Only the newest 50 are shown: see all in Finance › Supplier invoices.
